title: Genuine edge, or just luck?
author: Axonum
selftext:
Ran my automated options trading bot live for the first time this week and I'm shocked by the results. Wondering how I can validate if this is a genuine edge or just luck. Has anyone else ever tried a similar strategy? Also if anyone wants to try it on a paper account happy to let you test it yourself.
